user.title: Haier HWHP – connection
user.description: Connection details for the Modbus TCP interface. The HWHP's native interface is Modbus RTU (9600 8N1), so the host is usually a Modbus RTU-to-TCP converter (gateway).

data_description.host: Usually the IP of the Modbus RTU-to-TCP converter, not the heat pump itself.
data_description.slave: Modbus address of the heat pump on the RTU bus (default 1).

cop.title: Haier HWHP – COP & energy
cop.description: COP = produced heat / electricity used. Leave a meter empty to use the device's integrated Modbus register; pick an entity to use an external meter. Tip: for an external electricity meter, pick a yearly-resetting counter (utility_meter, cycle: yearly) so the window matches the device's yearly heat total. Changeable later via "Configure".

data.cop_elec_entity: External electricity meter (kWh) — empty = Modbus register
data.cop_heat_entity: External heat meter (kWh) — empty = Modbus register
data.cop_ref_date: COP reference date (empty = auto; day the heat counter was reset)

pv.title: Haier HWHP – PV mode
pv.description: Optional PV-surplus control. Pick the operating mode: Off (only the raw entities + 38 °C guard), Coordinator (the integration controls the setpoint itself from the raw PV surplus + a fixed morning start), or Executor (an external HEMS controls it via select.haier_hwhp_pv_program). The next page shows exactly the fields for the chosen mode. Changeable later via "Configure".

data_description.pv_mode: Off: the integration does not regulate (only the raw entities + 38 °C guard). Coordinator: the integration controls the setpoint from the raw PV surplus (morning start, hold/lower, daytime re-raise, high tier). Executor: an external HEMS controls it via the pv_program select; the integration only provides the programs.

pv_details.title: Haier HWHP – PV settings
pv_details.description: Settings for the selected PV mode. Coordinator: surplus sensor, target temps and the control thresholds. Executor: only the target temps (the mechanic for the program select).

data_description.pv_sensor: Raw PV surplus in W (≥ 0). Required for Coordinator mode.
data_description.pv_hold: Stay at the normal target (65 °C) while surplus is above this; drop to base after the debounce time once it stays below.
data_description.pv_reraise_threshold: When enabled, raise back to the normal target during the day once surplus exceeds this again (anti-short-cycle still applies).
data_description.pv_high: Raise to the high target (75 °C) and run the escalation once surplus exceeds this (rare; also when the heat pump is off).
data_description.pv_morning_time: Once per day at this time, if the water is below the base target, kick the setpoint to the normal target (65 °C) so the heat pump starts within the device ECO window.
data_description.pv_min_off: Anti-short-cycle: a new cycle starts only after the compressor has been off this long. If it is already running, the tier is just extended (piggyback).
data_description.pv_escalation: What to add once surplus passes the high threshold (also when the heat pump is off — e.g. dump surplus into the heater after the daily cycle). None: just the higher target. Boost: heat pump + electric heater together (efficient). Electric heater only (ELEC): heater on, heat pump OFF — inefficient, only to dump surplus.

init.description: Connection, COP/energy sources and optional PV surplus control. Host/port/slave change the link to the Modbus converter.

data_description.emergency_enabled: When the water gets critically cold, temporarily switches ECO→AUTO to heat immediately (even outside the ECO time window); back to ECO on recovery.
data_description.emergency_critical: Below this water temperature it switches from ECO to AUTO.
data_description.emergency_recover: At/above this water temperature it switches back to ECO.
